integrity.proof_basis: Fixed-spine decomposition with page independence and inclusion-exclusion; finite computation is only a consistency check.
integrity.residual_literature_risk: An unindexed or inaccessible family-specific enumeration may exist; no inspected source implied the all-function polynomial.

scientific.claim_scope: Exact weight polynomial for every integer \(n\ge1\), plus total and minimum-layer counts.
limitations: The 2007 prism-equivalence paper was inspected through abstract and bibliographic material rather than readable full text.
No claim is made for rainbow parameters with more than two colors or for other rainbow-domination variants.
